claims: The 2026 Sidemen Charity Match took place on April 18, 2026.
The 2026 Sidemen Charity Match took place at Wembley Stadium.
Jack Joseph managed Sidemen FC in the 2026 Sidemen Charity Match.

The players for Sidemen FC in the 2026 Sidemen Charity Match were Zerkaa, Vikkstar123, Wroetoshaw, TBJZL, Deji, Marlon, Arthur TV, AmineMaTue, ChrisMD, xQc, Adapt, Jynxzi, Niko Omilana, AB, AJ Shabeel, LazarBeam, Lacy.
Calfreezy managed YouTube Allstars in the 2026 Sidemen Charity Match.

The players for YouTube Allstars in the 2026 Sidemen Charity Match were KSI, Miniminter, Behzinga, Angry Ginge, Stable Ronaldo, Squeezie, Mrwhosetheboss, JasonTheWeen, ItalianBach, Ibai, George Clarke, Danny Aarons, Chazza, CarryMinati, Sketch, WillNE, Max Fosh.
The YouTube Allstars won the 2026 Sidemen Charity Match in a penalty shootout after a 10-10 draw.
Jynxzi of Sidemen FC was the MVP of the 2026 Sidemen Charity Match.
Miniminter of YouTube Allstars was the Golden Boot winner of the 2026 Sidemen Charity Match.
The 2026 Sidemen Charity Match raised over £6 million for Bright Side and M7 Education.
